# 2. Custom Functions

```{r}
#| label: custom-functions
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

# Extracts fixed effects from a brms model into a clean, rounded dataframe
extract_brms_summary <- function(model, model_name) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$fixed)
  s$Term <- rownames(s)
  s$Model <- model_name
  rownames(s) <- NULL
  
  s <- s |> 
    dplyr::select(Model, Term, Estimate, Est.Error, `l-95% CI`, `u-95% CI`, Rhat, Bulk_ESS, Tail_ESS) |> 
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
  
  return(s)
}
```
